mapper.select: select log_id, tenant_id, menu_id, status, operate_time, operate_by, reason from hc_customer_menu_status_log where IFNULL(is_deleted,0)=0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} and menu_id = #{menuId} AND IFNULL(is_deleted,0)=0 order by operate_time desc
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hc_customer_menu_status_log (log_id, tenant_id, menu_id, status, operate_time, operate_by, reason, is_deleted) VALUES (#{logId}, #{tenantId}, #{menuId}, #{status}, #{operateTime}, #{operateBy}, #{reason}, 0)
